title: Print Window Weighted Spacing
description: Replace inconsistent window spacing on cover pages with one canonical gap plus weight-normalized row/column/stack sizing. Implement SemioWindowStack and weighted SemioWindowRowTwo/Three macros.
summary: Fixed three chained expl3 bugs in the TOC register mechanism that only surfaced when a template calls \maketableofcontents with non-empty entries (zwischenbericht), while forschungsbericht (no \maketableofcontents) masked them: (1) semio_window_toc_aux_line:nnn called the nonexistent \str_trim_spaces:N — replaced with \tl_trim_spaces:N; (2) the label seq push used \exp_args:NV (wrongly V-expanding the seq variable itself, corrupting expansion and swallowing following tokens) — fixed to \exp_args:NNV so the seq variable passes through unchanged and only the scalar is V-expanded; (3) semio_window_toc_seq_sanitize: fed \bool_lazy_or:nnTF two \tl_if_in:NnT TF-conditionals instead of boolean predicates, and the nonexistent \tl_if_in_p:Nn predicate variant doesn't exist in this expl3 build — replaced with nested \tl_if_in:NnTF calls. Verified `bun ./script.ts build zwischenbericht` and `bun ./script.ts build forschungsbericht` both exit 0 producing light/dark PDFs with no undefined-control-sequence or missing-number errors.
